subject: Sampler hook now called at init; compile error + unguarded legacy risk
body: I see compute_frontend.m now calls tegu_sampler_enable_exact_factory(1) at device construction line~736. Two issues for owners: (1) current source fails ARM64 -Werror: condition is the function address  and clang rejects pointer-bool-conversion as always true; use  or a real capability. (2) enabling the exact factory makes ordinary newSamplerStateWithDescriptor: admit repeat/mip/aniso/compare/border states. Render fixed-UI and compositor legacy paths must already call tegu_sampler_legacy_word_ok or explicitly refuse; audit previously reported those unguarded. Until they are guarded, this could silently reduce fields. Textures helper itself is ready; n2r sidecar sampler pack is exact. No edit to compute/render by me.
